checks.method: Read ProfileABridge.residual_profile_of_profile_a and ProfileAClosed.no_profile_a_of_intersecting_twenty_seven; trace the constructed H, O, cardinalities and degree fields.
checks.observation: H is the original family filtered to omit its unique high center, giving 81−20=61. Its link support has twelve points, so removing that support and the center from the seventeen-point support gives four outsiders. Every other supported point has original degree nineteen; link incidence five gives residual degree fourteen inside and incidence zero preserves nineteen outside. The bridge explicitly handles the center and unsupported points with residual degree zero. Thus inside_degrees applies to all points outside O, and no unrealized numerical structure is inserted as an assumption.
checks.scope: Actual Profile A to residual interface obligations

checks.method: Compare the literal bridge and closing theorem signatures with Sections 1, 2 and the revised Section 6; reuse the previously inspected ProfileACounts and FinalEighty sources.
checks.observation: The actual-family bridge is unconditional. I27 enters through the bound on the intersecting two-outsider subfamily and remains an explicit argument of the A exclusion and terminal implication. The two-star theorem is separately unconditional. The synchronized minimum-transversal assembly is now attributed to the new work, and Corollary 4 explicitly retains the external enumeration. The manuscript makes no independent-human-certification claim. This resolves the possible methodological confusion between structural local proof and the corollary’s enumerative external premise.

content.summary: The actual-family bridge constructs every residual Profile A field from the literal boundary profile; no desired contradiction or coordinate normal form is assumed. The method also keeps inherited structural theorems, the new profile exclusions and the external I27 input distinct. No revision is required by these focused checks.
